claims.claim: The eight-metric temporal profile candidate schema preserves exact metric names, units and F-CI14 normalization/zero-limit semantics without introducing numeric defaults.
Calibration and validation raw-observation sets are nonempty, unique and disjoint, and candidate limits/scope are frozen before validation.
Every admitted observation requires separate PASS hard-mass gates for full and split paths; mass and solver tolerances cannot be reused as temporal limits.
Held-out validation uses the qualified F-CI14 max-of-ratios and zero-limit semantics, and every validation observation must pass without retuning the frozen profile.
Optional-process scope remains fail-closed: a water-only profile cannot claim complete crop, irrigation, heat, solute or WOFOST temporal coverage.
Real B1.10 calibration and held-out validation observation datasets exist and are independently admitted.
claims.blocker: F-VQ09 qualified only the harness contract; no real admitted F-VQ09 temporal observations exist yet.

claims.claim: Physical per-metric temporal limits are independently justified and qualified.
claims.blocker: F-CI14 numeric limits remain null; F-VQ10 introduces no numeric values.
